boundaries: One next-token probe per test prompt
Directly optimized PCA coordinates are an ordinary low-rank baseline; equal performance is not Mirror-specific

compute.gpu_latency: CUDA unavailable; no GPU serving claim

controls: Full independent attention-weighted affine ridge maps
Rank-32 PCA reconstruction with projected ridge coefficients unmodified
Same rank-32 PCA basis with per-role coefficients optimized by target next-token NLL (ordinary low-rank/shared-basis adaptation control)

development.optimizer: Adam on per-role rank-32 codes only; target weights and shared basis frozen
development.selection_metric: held-out dev next-token NLL after exactly 24 updates for each learning-rate candidate; ties broken by lower lr

failure_gate: At least two of three fresh seeds miss any required quality gate or byte gate; or prompt identity/serialization correctness fails.

fixed_design.position_rule: inverse source RoPE before key fitting; apply target RoPE after translation; values unrotated

fresh.prompt_identity: exact source/target tokenizer offset alignment; deterministic seed-disjoint calibration/test row chunks

hypothesis: With fixed [0,4,7] source-head support, target-NLL calibration of rank-32 shared-basis KV-map codes improves held-out target NLL over unmodified PCA-projected codes while retaining at least 50% actual serialized-byte savings versus independent attention-weighted ridge maps.
logical_multiplicity: Per-target-role cache bridge functions addressable as small shared-basis coordinates.
mirror_coordinate: Rank-32 coefficient vector per target layer/head/KV role, optimized through the target causal next-token objective.
physical_object: Fixed support per-layer source-to-target affine KV maps represented in one shared PCA basis.
prior_art_boundary: PA237 establishes the relevant attention-weighted closed-form bridge control. PA227 motivates sensitivity-aware coordinates only by analogy; this is not an Engram/Fisher experiment or reproduction.

storage.common_model_weights: reported separately; excluded from marginal bridge payload comparison

success_gate: In all three fresh seeds, optimized rank-32 codes improve test NLL over unmodified rank-32 PCA by >=0.10 nat, are within +0.50 nat of native target and full ridge, and actual rank-32 serialized bytes are <=50% of full-map bytes.
title: Attention-sensitive calibration of shared cross-model KV bridge codes

post_fresh_amendment.reason: Add native-to-bridge logit KL and RMSE diagnostics required by the registry quality map.
